notes: Fixes categories (and services) getting auto-re-translated over and over even when their name/text genuinely hadn't changed: the hourly catalog sync compared raw text byte-for-byte to decide if something changed, so an invisible difference like a non-breaking space vs a regular space in the same spot looked like a real edit and wiped every language's translation to force a redo. Text is now normalized before comparing. Also logs the exact before/after text whenever a real change is detected, so any future case like this is easy to diagnose from the logs instead of guessing. No database update needed for this update.
